motion.name: preloader
motion.purpose: 000/100 ink overlay GSAP tween, dismissed on cm:ready; skipped under reduced-motion.

motion.name: marquee-x
motion.purpose: Mobile surfaces strip below the hero.

motion.name: marquee-y
motion.purpose: Hero surfaces vertical loop on desktop.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals on [data-reveal]: y28 fade, once at top 88%. Hero has no entrance.

motion.name: overlay
motion.purpose: Mobile menu overlay fade plus link stagger on open, fade on close.

shadows.name: brutal
shadows.purpose: Default hard offset on light grounds.

body.purpose: Proof lines and outcomes at 1rem/1.6 Montserrat.

display.purpose: Hero name and section titles, uppercase Barlow Condensed.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges, ledgers at 0.72rem/0.25em Space Mono.

dos: Do keep 3px ink borders, hard shadows, and 44px targets on everything interactive.
Do keep repo URLs always visible or one toggle away.
Do keep the hero settled on first paint; reserve motion for the tweened preloader, surfaces marquee, scroll reveals, and overlay fade.
Do freeze all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep landmarks, a visible 3px focus ring, and a skip link.
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradient wash, glow, or shadow outside the 3px hard grid.
Don't add stats, metrics, testimonials, or product copy the repos don't support.
Don't invent mockups, screenshots, emulators, or carousels — cards plus repo links are the evidence.
Don't wire the chatbot to anything but the curated answers file.
Don't replace Barlow Condensed / Montserrat / Space Mono without a rebrand decision.
keyCharacteristics: Cream-first neo-brutalism — 3px ink borders, hard 3px shadows, outline display type
Hero renders settled on first paint — no entrance animation, no ledger, fits 1440x900
Numbered project cards carry the evidence, not mockups or carousels
Four motions only: tweened preloader plus surfaces marquee plus scroll reveal plus overlay fade
narrative.overview: Cream first, loud borders, honest proof. Sticky nav plus badge plus giant condensed name with outline surname plus CTAs, then About fact-grid, Proficient/Familiar stack, numbered projects with Live/WIP pills and repo pills, ending in an intent-select mailto composer.

rules.body: No sky blue, no chrome wash. Meaning comes from ink-cream inversion and border weight, never from a hue accent.
rules.name: The Contrast-Is-The-Accent Rule

rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and whitespace — never from extra colors or decoration.
rules.name: The Type Does The Work Rule

rules.body: Surfaces lift by exactly one hard offset. No blur, no glow, no box-shadow larger than the 3px grid.
rules.name: The Hard-Shadow-Only Rule
